programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: January 20th, 1992 High over Frances mountainous Alsace region, Air Inter Flight #148 starts its descent towards Strasbourg airport. An Airbus A320, the aircraft is the worlds first to rely mainly on computerized commands to control it, and while its autopilot had been programmed to land on a specific runway, high winds and poor winter weather mean the pilots must take over the controls to land on another runway. Slightly off course, a controller guides the pilots as they prepare to make a visual landing. But as they descend through the clouds, the aircraft suddenly rips through the treetops below and slams into the side of a mountain. Can rescuers locate the survivors in time? And can investigators figure out what caused the crash?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Chalks Ocean Airways Flight #101 Grumman Turbo Mallard (sea plane) December 19th, 2005 Destined for the Bahamas, Chalks Ocean Airways Flight #101 is preparing for takeoff in the waters off Miami Beach, Florida. Part plane, part speedboat, the twin turbo-prop taxis through one of the worlds busiest ports, and after a smooth takeoff, climbs towards the clouds. A minute later, however, just as the plane is climbing through 500 feet, it is suddenly rocked by an explosion and, from the beach, a tourist films the aircrafts catastrophic plunge into the ocean. Lifeguards immediately race to the crash site but there are no survivors. Eyewitness reports and the tourist video confirm one of its wings ripped off in mid-air. But can investigators determine why?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Making a routine journey from Berlin, Crossair Flight #3597 is on its final approach to Zurich. It is one of the last planes scheduled to land. But just minutes before landing the pilots cannot find the runway. They decide to abort the maneuver and apply full power to all four engines in order to get their jet to climb. But they are too late. The aircraft clips the treetops below and crashes into a hillside. Investigators comb through the wreckage, and the data from the plane's black boxes. But they would only solve the riddle of Crossair Flight 3597 by digging into the past.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Witness: Disaster in Japan
programme.desc: On March 11, 2011, a 9.0 magnitude earthquake struck 75 miles off the eastern coast of Japan. Almost immediately, tsunami warnings blared, urging residents along Japan's coast to quickly move to higher ground. For the next several hours, residents watched in stunned horror as a series of massive waves slammed into the coast, inundating entire towns and sweeping across the countryside, laying waste to everything in its path. Throughout, amateur videographers, news crews, government agencies, tourists, and countless others were recording the sights and sounds of the unfolding catastrophe. Weaving together their footage, Witness: Japan's Disaster reconstructs the earthquake and tsunami as they happened, entirely through the eyes of those who experienced them.

programme.title: Earthquake on Everest
programme.desc: On April 25th, an earthquake unleashed terror on Everest. Eighteen people died and 61 were injured in the worst disaster in the mountain's history. Now, never-seen-before footage from the moment the earthquake struck reveals the horror of those fatal minutes both on Everest and in surrounding Nepal where over 8,500 people died. Eyewitness accounts tell of survival and loss while scientists on the ground reveal how this disaster impacted the scientific community's knowledge of Himalayan earthquakes.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In Brazil, David Blaine seeks inspiration by immersing himself in his hosts' vibrant energy, passion and spontaneity. The exceptional daredevils, artists, explorers and athletes he encounters unite to help him bring an audacious feat to life that's lingered in his dreams for years.

In this documentary series we follow Alaska's pilots as they risk their lives to ensure their fellow citizens are safe and well. Flying through some of the most dangerous skies in the country, where treacherous conditions can change in an instant, these pilots use all their experience and knowledge to safely get to those in need.

programme.title: Alaska Wing Men
programme.desc: Extended daylight hours in the "Land of the Midnight Sun" mean high season for DRAKE OLSON, but a faulty engine belt threatens to upend his schedule. RYAN McCUE is transporting supplies and personnel to a desolate mining site on Prince of Wales Island when bad weather forces him to weigh the risks of a forced landing. In Kodiak, KELLER WATTUM is spotting fish from the sky for the crew of the CRIMSON BEAUTY during the annual herring fishery. Meanwhile, DON LEE helps a group of aviation enthusiasts in Talkeetna rebuild an old Cherokee Six airplane from the 60's, before supplying his buddy and Alaskan bush resident, Willy Ivey, with an Alaskan staple.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Continent 7: Antarctica
programme.desc: Six different teams of scientists, each studying different areas and aspects of Antarctica arrive on the continent after years in the planning and millions of dollars of expense. The continent is home to the coldest, windiest, driest conditions on the planet, and without Scott Base, the hub of Antarctica New Zealand's missions these teams couldn't survive. One team has come to study the inner workings of Mount Erebus, the southernmost active volcano on the planet. Another is traversing onto the Ross Ice Shelf, a floating piece of ice the size of France. Two thousand miles away, the Antarctic Peninsula Team is looking to tag whales and track their movements. Each team's results could have massive implications to better understanding how climate change is affecting life around the world.

programme.title: Continent 7: Antarctica
programme.desc: Scientists deployed to Antarctica are accustomed to frigid temperatures, but few have experienced the condition one storm that is sweeping over Scott Base and the Ross Ice Shelf. A condition one storm is categorized by visibility less than 100 feet, wind speed over 60 miles per hour or air temperature less than negative 100 degrees. The consequences can be deadly. Scott Base shuts down all missions and flights to and from western Antarctica have been canceled; leaving them more isolated from the outside world than ever. The scientists already 60 miles away from the safety of base on the Ross Ice Shelf have no choice but to stay in their tents and hunker down until the storm subsides. Those on the water aren't faring any better. 2000 miles away, a team studying minke whales is stranded from their main vessel because of snow reducing visibility, and the US Coast Guard en route to help resupply the continent is nearing the perpetual weather system that swirls around Antarctica.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to the home counties where a 1955 Ford Popular awaits. However, this is no bog-standard classic, it's a highly modified hot-rod with a brute of a V8 engine and a whole host of problems. The car was once the pride and joy of cerebral palsy sufferer Andy, but with so many mechanical troubles his beloved "Pop" has been rotting away in storage with virtually no chance of getting it back on the road. Until, that is, his wife wrote in to Car SOS.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz restore Adam's Datsun 240k Skyline, a rare Japanese classic that hails from the 1970s.After a long spell of ill health Adam's wife is desperate for him to have his beloved car back on the road, but with only two other similar cars currently registered on the road, not only is this the rarest vehicle the Car SOS team has ever taken on, it means part finding is an almost impossible task.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Master mechanics Fuzz Townshend and parts-blagging petrol head Tim Shaw are back for a brand new season of the fan favourite show Car S.O.S. The comedy duo have their work-cut out as they embark on more undercover missions rescuing classic cars and returning them in a surprise reveal to their much deserving owners. This season starts with a exhaust bang, as Tim and Fuzz are on a special mission to rescue a unique classic racing car and reunite it with a true racing legend...Sir Stirling Moss! But this 1962 Austin Healy Sebring Sprite, that once raced in a team that included Sir Stirling Moss, isn't in a fit state. But the guys have a plan to get this car back on the racetrack and Sir Stirling Moss back in the driving seat. Fuzz begins work in the garage whilst Tim goes in search of the original engine, and also finding time along the way to have a sit down with the racing legend himself. Will the Sprite be ready in time for Sir Stirling Moss to take it out for a spin? The guys also come across a supercar that's begging to be taken back to the swinging '60s, the Jaguar E-type. But the car's owner Mick is suffering from osteoporosis and has lost all hope that his beloved car will ever be back to its full glory. But Tim and Fuzz are working with Mick's family in secret to restore the car and give Mick a brilliant surprise. But when they discover it's a back to metal restoration this car looks like it's going to be more of a head-ache than a head-turner. Other cars festering away waiting for the guy's attention are Tim's all-time favourite: the Audi Quattro Turbo, the 3 wheeled 1934 Morgan F4, a retro 1982 Mk1 GTI and a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR. So start up those engines, as Tim and Fuzz return this month for the ultimate car show with a heart.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Adventurer and YouTuber Eva zu Beck has climbed Mount Kilimanjaro before. But like all who make that trek, she hiked with a team of porters who carried the tents, food and equipment needed for such a grueling expedition. Now, Eva heads back to Africa's tallest mountain to challenge herself to get to the summit as a porter herself. But the porters on Eva's climb are different from most on Kilimanjaro. They're a predominantly female team who face discrimination from those who feel the job is best done by men, but they've persevered in order to provide for their children. As Eva hikes the high-altitude trails with these women, she learns that the source of their strength is more mental than physical. Eva then uses their inspiration to overcome an unexpected challenge along the way.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Adventurer and YouTuber Eva zu Beck has run ultramarathons before. But running an ultra in Mexico's Copper Canyon with the Rarámuri people tests her mental and physical limits like never before. The Rarámuri are known worldwide for their ability to run extremely long distances without the use of cushioned sneakers or the high-tech supplements that endurance athletes typically rely on. It's a superskill that this community has honed for hundreds of years. Even their name, Rarámuri, means "light-footed" or "those who run well." After learning how the Rarámuri fuel up for long runs, Eva trains by playing the traditional game of ariwete on the rocky trails along the canyon—all in homemade sandals. Finally, she challenges herself to run 27 miles in the intense heat and treacherous terrain alongside a team of local women.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. In one of the larger busts of the year, a nondescript Spaniard is found with 10 kilos of cocaine in his luggage. A passenger is arrested with 38 capsules of liquid cocaine in his body. And a shipment of powdered maca, a nutritious Andean root, raises flags. An expert chemist must confirm if the maca also contains cocaine!

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The biggest cocaine busts from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A man traveling to the DR, hides cocaine in children's organizers. A stepmom and daughter conceal bricks of cocaine inside jackets. A mother with a child carries cocaine in food packages and kid's clothes. The Anti-narcotics police find cocaine in a shipment of fresh herbs. A man going to Mexico with cocaine bricks in his carry-on. A man with liquid cocaine in beverage bottles.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Stories of suspects who almost got away from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A farmer swaps his suitcase with an accomplice in the terminal. A man who ingested cocaine is able to board a plane, but through international police coordination, is apprehended at his destination. A man with capsules in his stomach holds out for 36 hours and must be released. His sister is arrested. Cocaine cargo has been chemically disguised to fool officials.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Taking off during a major storm, a brand-new 737 falls from the sky over West Africa, and an international group of investigators soon descends on Cameroon. Submerged in mud and water, Kenya Airlines Flight 507 crashed into a mangrove swamp, killing everyone on board. And while investigators ultimately pinpoint one fatal mistake that triggered the tragedy, they also uncover a lethal cascade of issues that sent the passenger jet spiralling toward the ground.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route from Bogota to the tiny Caribbean island of San Andres, Aires Flight 8250 is rocked by a major tropical storm. And though the crew expects to emerge from the intense weather, they are pummeled by high winds and heavy rains on their final approach and slam into the ground just short of the runway. The pilots claim the weather is to blame, but investigators ultimately reveal the cause of the accident was in their heads.

programme.title: Witches: Truth Behind the Trials
programme.desc: What is a witch? Why did people hunt them? And how did societies tear themselves apart trying to root out such supposed evil? This special episode tells the origin story of the first major witch hunts and trials in Europe during the 16th century. Beginning with Trier in Germany, a terrifying and brutal event engulfs everyone, from lowly peasants to the richest members of society. Shortly after these events, King James VI of Scotland, convinced that dark forces were conspiring against him, embarked on a quest to eliminate all witches from his country.

programme.title: Witches: Truth Behind the Trials
programme.desc: Countries across Europe continue to fall victim to the unrelenting witch trials. This special episode paints a vivid portrait of how the witch hunts keep spreading. In 1645, two self-appointed witch-hunters, Matthew Hopkins and John Stearne, roamed across England, investigating and torturing so-called witches in exchange for money. Then, in 1688, an event known as "The Great Noise" witnessed hysteria spread across parts of Sweden, driven by children telling stories of a fantastical place where they were taken by witches who cavorted with the devil.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 4000 years ago, in hand-built canoes, people dare to venture into the unexplored Pacific Ocean, searching for islands to start new lives on. Over countless generations they voyage from Taiwan to Vanuatu and beyond. Guided by the sea, stars and the stories of their ancestors, they become master navigators, and unlock a sea of islands. But ocean exploration brings great risks. To overcome merciless natural barriers, these voyagers must deeply understand the brutally powerful Pacific. They build homes on thousands of islands, developing rich cultures filled with song, dance and legends of the sea. But after discovering Fiji, Samoa and Tonga, they find no more islands. Their ocean world remains connected by their canoes, and for 1000 years voyagers sail into unknown, perilous waters, hoping that one day the sea will lead them to new lands.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: Pacific voyagers set sail heading east. For the last 1000 years they have sailed between settled islands, stretching from Fiji to the Philippines, and unsuccessfully searched for new islands. Now, with bigger, stronger double hull canoes, amazing navigators find the paradise islands of Tahiti. However, for these adventurous voyagers, this is just the beginning. Fearlessly they cross wild, stormy seas and voyage into the unexplored Pacific. Following the winds and their ancestors' stories they find the tiny Easter Island. The birds lead them to Hawai'i and they follow whales and the stars of Maui's Hook to New Zealand. They find every island in the Pacific and strong cultures evolve. Empires are established and warriors fight brutal sea battles. But when European boats cross the horizon, this ocean world will change forever.

programme.title: Ancient China from Above
programme.desc: Guarded by the Terracotta Warriors, the tomb of the First Emperor is so revered that it has never been opened. But now, for the first time ever, Sam Willis and his team of experts use new laser drone technology to investigate. What they reveal has never been seen before, and it provides new insight into what lies inside the tomb itself, as they piece together the Emperor's vast mausoleum - an entire, stunning city of the dead.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The Inca fortress of Sacsayhuamán stands high above Cusco as a colossal mystery of construction. Its gargantuan stones, so precisely fitted, seem to defy rational explanation and have given rise to tales of demonic assistance. Deep in Rajasthan, India, the Chand Baori stepwell plunges 13 stories into the earth, its 3,500 perfectly arranged steps forming a hypnotic geometry so meticulous that locals whisper of unholy pacts. And in the heart of Paris, the Notre-Dame Cathedral soars skyward, its Gothic spires and intricate ironwork pushed medieval engineering to such extremes that stories circulated of dark bargains. Did the creators of these structures truly strike a "deal with the devil," or do these wonders simply reflect the often-misunderstood genius of our ancestors?

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: From ancient temples to soaring cathedrals, humanity's deepest beliefs have given rise to sacred architecture. Rome's Pantheon, with its perfect dome and mysterious oculus, blends beauty and functionality in ways that puzzle modern architects to this day. Rising majestically from the sea, the gravity-defying Mont Saint-Michel reveals the extraordinary vision and skill of its builders, who overcame tides and challenging foundations to construct a monastery high on a rocky island. And the Porta Nigra, the best-preserved Roman city gate north of the Alps, finds its fate hanging in the balance until a Greek hermit's arrival transforms this military stronghold into a sacred sanctuary, ensuring its survival through the centuries.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Since the dawn of humanity, we have looked to the cosmos to understand our world. In the lush jungles of Southeast Asia, Khmer King Suryavarman II commissioned Angkor Wat, an elaborate stone masterpiece devoted to Vishnu. With precise measurements embedded into its very foundations, this temple is an ornate blueprint of the Hindu universe. Across the globe, another structure in Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula stands in tribute to the heavens. A relic of the ancient Maya civilization, the Pyramid of Kukulcan displays the divine light of the equinoctial sun across its façade, while hiding sacred secrets beneath. In Ireland, a near-forgotten cairn harbors mysteries illuminated by the winter sun. Newgrange, an ancestral tomb built by neolithic farmers, is adorned with strange carvings and features a cosmic design centuries ahead of its time.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, fight the most daring and unexpected attempts to smuggle drugs out of the country. Behind the apparent innocence of a young woman traveling with her stepmother, the officers stop one of the biggest drug smuggling attempts in years. Later, they won't believe their eyes when the X-ray machine reveals that a young man is wearing a cocaine-filled adult diaper. Immigration officers must contend with an out of control Cuban passenger to whom they are forced to deport. Later, tragedy unfolds when they must prevent a mother from traveling with her young daughter to Europe. A thrifty passenger manages to pass through all airport security check-points with two kilograms of cocaine hidden in his carry-on bag, but he will be cornered as the officers' well-trained sense of smell will trigger and make him a suspect. A passenger on her way to the Dominican Republic denies being the owner of a bag as it's about to be searched. The inspection will reveal something unexpected.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: A fisherman's tip leads Air and Marine agents in the U.S. Virgin Islands to over 80 kilos of cocaine washed ashore on a public beach. Two fishing vessels are intercepted between the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico, suspected of smuggling drugs. Agents from the Fajardo unit patrol remote trails showing signs of drug trafficking routes.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: U.S. Virgin Islands Air and Marine agents chase a boat through international waters into the British Virgin Islands, ultimately seizing over 1,800 kilos of cocaine. The Mayagüez unit responds to a call about a capsized migrant vessel and finds suspicious bundles floating at sea. Agent Andujar and his team in Fajardo come across suspected smugglers operating a modified vessel.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more, discovering new habitats. Bertie Gregory learns about penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their continuing search for new worlds.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Survival of the Smartest. Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. Riding powerful currents, the tiny adventurers arrived in strange new lands, reshaping traditions for deserts, tropics... and even among humans.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators: Compilation
programme.desc: Rivers and oceans are ruthless battlefields, constantly testing the bravery of even the biggest and deadliest carnivores.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more, discovering new habitats. Bertie Gregory learns about penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their continuing search for new worlds.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: This is the real story of the jungles made famous in Rudyard Kipling's 'Jungle Book'. It is a battlefield ruled by tooth and claw, where species fight for space, water, food, and mating rights. This is a world that knows nothing of compassion or kindness, dominated by two of the world's top predators, the Bengal Tiger and the Indian Wild Dog or Dhole. Kipling's Jungle Book was fiction. This is hard fact and a story that rewrites itself every year

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Cecil: The Legacy of A King
programme.desc: In the heart of Zimbabwe's Hwange National Park, beneath towering mahogany and mopani trees, roamed one of Africa's most legendary lions-Cecil. Known for his immense size and regal presence, he was a dominant force in the wild long before his tragic fate at the hands of hunters made global headlines. While his death sparked international outrage, Cecil: The Legacy of a King shifts the focus to his extraordinary life. A warrior, a father, and a leader, Cecil's story is one of strength, survival, and the bonds that define a pride. This documentary honors the legacy of a lion who was more than just a symbol-he was a king.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: An Elephant's World
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular. But look closer and the desert reveals a SECRET WORLD of INTRIGUE… surprising stories of survival, epic perseverance… and things you've never seen before. All of America's deserts provide something… a hidden bounty for those who know where to find it… and how to use it. Title Final Yes

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands, slackens at the shoals of the fall line, floods across vast deltas, and reunites with the wild ocean. It's an immersive encounter with stunning wildlife, up-close natural history, and surprising revelations from source to sea. Discover a waterworld populated by hellbender salamanders, prehistoric sturgeon, endangered raptors, and playful manatees. A place we call the American Amazon — a hotspot of biodiversity rivaling anywhere on Earth — is full of stories that have never been told.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: There are still places on Earth where fields of grass stretch as far as the eye can see. In order to survive in these open spaces, predators must hide in plain sight. On the vast plains of the African savanna, banded mongooses rely on strength in numbers in order to succeed in a land of giants. Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: One Continent - Five Worlds. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni domā, ka ēdiens spēj likt tiem mainīt krāsu un formu, tāpēc izlemj atrast katram piemēroto ēdienu. Barbabo nav iedvesmas, tāpēc vairs nespēj radīt. Visa ģimene palīdz, iesakot jaunas zīmējumu tēmas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ķīmiskas villas padara lauku apvidu rožainu. Barbapapas uzbūvē putnu māju, lai pasargātu sasirgušos putnus. Ieraugot piesārņotu pludmali, Barbapapu ģimene izlemj to uzkopt. No drazām top mini golfa laukums.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vērojot zvaignzes Barbatētis un Lolita pamana lidojošo šķivīti un steidz pamodināt visu ģimeni. Izrādās, ka ciemos atlidojuši draugi, kuriem līdzi ir lielkājains mazulis, kurš pēkšņi uzradās viņu planētā. Ģimene ar kosmosa kuģi dodas mazuļa planētas meklējumos. // Barbatētis cer, ka viņi drīz atradīs mazuļa planētu. Bet ne viss iet pēc plāna un viņi nolaižas uz ļoti dīvainas planētas. Kā viņi tiks prom un vai atradīs mazuļa planētu?

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja sastrīdas un sāk meklēt jaunus labākos draugus. // Tims un Kaja sacenšas zvaigžņu medībās pa visu Rambltonu. // Kad Tija noguļ iespēju redzēt griezošo zvaigzni, Tims mēģina tādu uztaisīt pats.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz tantei Celtnei, kas izaicina Ātrmeistaru noskaidrot, kurš ir ātrākais braucējs Celtnieklīcī. Kad ērglis Vingsija nespēj pacelties gaisā, Rabla komanda kopā ar Dr. Divu palīdz viņai atkal iemācīties lidot.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

Uzzinot, ka Deizija, Deizijas mamma, un vecmāmiņa Zenija ir radinieki, Krokodila kungs neredz, kur viņš iederas. Viņš domā, ka viņam jāpieliek papildu pūles un jāatstāj iespaids uz vecmāmiņu Zeniju, lai iekarotu viņas mīlestību. Taču katrs mēģinājums beidzas ar neveiksmi, un viņš baidās, ka nekad neiekaros viņas sirdi.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Kamēr ģimene veido keramikas izstrādājumus, Barbabravo un Barbagudrais mēģina uzstādīt pasaules rekordu ar siera suflē. Barbapapas nolemj doties uz parku. Kamēr brālis un māsa spēlējas, Barbaliba mēģina visu kontrolēt.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabella pieskata Bali kaķēnus. Viņa baidās, kaut kas var noiet greizi, tāpēc nelaiž tos ārā. Barbamammai jāpalīdz kaķēniem.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Šodien būs pirmā skolas diena... Ja Rabla komanda pabeigs būvēt skolu! Bebrs grib visu ūdeni savākt sev, tāpēc komandai jāizdomā, kā glābt Zojas augus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dorai uzdāvina kucēnu, bet kaķītis Lakijs kļūst greizsirdīgs un aizbēg no mājām. Dora dodas viņam atgādināt, ka visi viņu ļoti mīl. Svarīgas čempionāta spēles dienā visi Doras draugi sasirgst ar šķavām. Dora palīdz komandai izveseļoties!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbatētis un Barbamamma paziņo bērniem, ka divatā dosies atpūsties uz Lieldienu salu. Barbabērni, dvīņi un Stingrā kungs dodas izbraucienā ar jahtu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbazū gatavs palīdzēt, bet Barbagudrais un Barbabella ļaunprātīgi izmanto viņa labestību un padara viņu traku. Barbazū nejauši atklāj spēju atdarināt Barbatēti. Viņš to izmanto, lai sadalītu darbus brāļiem un māsām. Vai viņi to uzzinās?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni domā, ka ēdiens spēj likt tiem mainīt krāsu un formu, tāpēc izlemj atrast katram piemēroto ēdienu. Barbabo nav iedvesmas, tāpēc vairs nespēj radīt. Visa ģimene palīdz, iesakot jaunas zīmējumu tēmas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vecākus pārsteidz aizvien vairāku reklāmas izkārtņu parādīšanās gar viņu ceļu. Gaisma no reklāmām ir tik spoža, ka naktī vairs nevar saskatīt zvaigznes un visur ir tik daudz stabu! Pietiks! Ģimenei jārīkojas! // Barbalala vēlas kļūt par kovbojmeiteni un Barbazū ir apņēmies viņai palīdzēt. Lai to panāktu, viņai jāiemācās aprūpēt govis un bulli. Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un tētis netiek prom attāla asteroīda. Tims, Kaja un Tomijs cenšas dabūt laukā bumbu no mammas istabas. Tims cenšas dabūt lejā Tijas jauno balonu, kas ieķēries kokā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda vēlas izcept vi lielāko pankūku! Taču situācija kļūst sarežģīta, kad Ātrmeistars grib visu sabojāt. Kad Kamilas lidmašīna kļūst netīra, vedot mājās pīles, kucēni atrod veidu, kā nomazgāt lidmašīnu... debesīs!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Deizija un Krokodilkungs atrod mazu ķirzaku, kas grib līdzināties Krokodilkungam. Vinstons grib būt pārgājiena līderis, bet viņa augsto tehnoloģiju ierīces dēļ visi apmaldās mežā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ķīmiskas villas padara lauku apvidu rožainu. Barbapapas uzbūvē putnu māju, lai pasargātu sasirgušos putnus. Ieraugot piesārņotu pludmali, Barbapapu ģimene izlemj to uzkopt. No drazām top mini golfa laukums.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vērojot zvaignzes Barbatētis un Lolita pamana lidojošo šķivīti un steidz pamodināt visu ģimeni. Izrādās, ka ciemos atlidojuši draugi, kuriem līdzi ir lielkājains mazulis, kurš pēkšņi uzradās viņu planētā. Ģimene ar kosmosa kuģi dodas mazuļa planētas meklējumos. // Barbatētis cer, ka viņi drīz atradīs mazuļa planētu. Bet ne viss iet pēc plāna un viņi nolaižas uz ļoti dīvainas planētas. Kā viņi tiks prom un vai atradīs mazuļa planētu?

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims dara visu, lai tiktu pie jaunās Dinozvaigznes figūriņas. Ir Astro-joku diena, bet Tims nezina, kad apstāties. Timam un tētim jānoķer traucējošs kurmis.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Kad Tija noguļ iespēju redzēt zvaigzni, kas griežas, Tims mēģina tādu uztaisīt pats.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Dvīņi ciemojas Barbagudrā istabā. Kādus sapņus sasniegtu, ja es būtu miljardieris?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ceļojumā uz Parīzi ģimene apskatīs lielisko Luvru. Diemžēl Barbalala neievēro strikto noteikumu - muzejā neēst. // Barbalala strikti ievēro ačgārnās dienas tradīcijas, kas cēlušās no seniem laikiem. Brāļi un māsas pievienojas viņai ačgārnajā dienā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vērojot zvaignzes Barbatētis un Lolita pamana lidojošo šķivīti un steidz pamodināt visu ģimeni. Izrādās, ka ciemos atlidojuši draugi, kuriem līdzi ir lielkājains mazulis, kurš pēkšņi uzradās viņu planētā. Ģimene ar kosmosa kuģi dodas mazuļa planētas meklējumos. // Barbatētis cer, ka viņi drīz atradīs mazuļa planētu. Bet ne viss iet pēc plāna un viņi nolaižas uz ļoti dīvainas planētas. Kā viņi tiks prom un vai atradīs mazuļa planētu?

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Deizija baidās, ka tiks sasaistīta ar Vinstonu uz mūžu, kad viņi sapinas lecamauklā. Deizija un Krokodilkungs palīdz Rolandam atrast draugu, ar kuru iet uz Zīļu šovu.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo neprot zīmēt. Viņam piemetas žagas, no kurām netiek vaļā. Viņš jau grasās padoties, kad nejauši rada jaunu mākslas novirzienu. Barbaliba grib piedalīties rakstīšanas konkursā, taču brāļi un māsas neļauj koncentrēties.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabravo kā slepenais aģents vada izmeklēšanu, bruņojies ar saviem rīkiem, lai uzzinātu, kurš nozaga Barbatēta torti. Barbalala ir pārliecināta, ka dzirdēja milzu vistu klīstam pa māju. Barbabērni stāv sardzē.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Pedro ir lipīgs klepus, drīz vien saslimst arī pārējie bērni. Kad laiks doties, saslimst arī pieaugušie. Arī Gazeles jaunkundze. Dakteris Lācis iedod negaršīgas zāles, bet kas rūpēsies par viņu, kad viņš saslims?

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Zābaciņš grib paaugties lielāks, lai drīkstētu vizināties karuseļos - taču kļūst milzīgs! Dora viņam palīdz atgūt ierasto izmēru. Mugursomai ir īpaša dāvana Dorai, bet tā nevar atvērties! Draugi dodas lūgt palīdzību vecmāmiņai.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Kad Tedijs un Fredijs ierodas pie Deizijas spēlēties, viņi atrod viņas senu mīļāko rotaļlietu - mazu zoss figūriņu vārdā Zosīte. Redzot, cik ļoti tā patīk viņas brāļiem, viņa to viņiem uzdāvina, atzīstot, ka vairs ar to nespēlējas. Tiklīdz tā atdota, viņa sāk ilgoties pēc Zosītes, it īpaši pēc tam, kad uzzina, ka zēni nomainījuši tās vārdu uz Dino Džims. Krokodila kungs nolemj palīdzēt Deizijai atgūt savu rotaļlietu un atrast aizvietotāju, ar ko zēni varētu spēlēties, bet dvīņi vēlas Zosīti!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais uztvēris melodiju no Marsa. Barbapapas būvē raķeti, lai dotos uz sarkano planētu. Ceļā uz Marsu Barbapapas sastop Barbamarsiešu ģimeni. Viņiem nav laika iepazīties, kad ciemam uzbrūk milzu augs.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pastaigas laikā Barbapapas atrod megalītu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda vēlas izcept vi lielāko pankūku! Taču situācija kļūst sarežģīta, kad Ātrmeistars grib visu sabojāt. Kad Kamilas lidmašīna kļūst netīra, vedot mājās pīles, kucēni atrod veidu, kā nomazgāt lidmašīnu... debesīs!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kucēnu iemīļotajām grāmatām iznācis turpinājums! Tām nav vietas bibliotēkā, tāpēc kucēniem jābūt radošiem!

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad fermeres Zojas fermas dzīvnieki traucē skeiteriem, Rabla komanda atrod risinājumu. // Hadlijs var palikt bez viesnīcas, kad Ātrmeistars viņam liek apsolīt neizpildāmo. Varbūt vienīgi Raba komanda ar savām būvēšanas prasmēm spēs izglāb viesnīcut!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora palīdz pelēnam Peresam salabot burvju zobu suku, lai varētu saņemt dāvanu par savu izkritušo zobu. Dora iepazīstas ar kāpuru Karlosu, kurš vēlas kļūt pr tauriņu! Lai tas notiktu, draugiem viņam jāatrod sviestogu cienasts.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Sam wants lessons from Carly on how to be girlier and be a better person to attract her classmate, Pete. At the end of the episode, Pete arrives at the Groovy Smoothie, ready to go on a date with Sam. The bully at school, Jocelyn also arrives to bother the iCarly team. So Sam beats her up, not knowing that Pete was watching. Meanwhile, Spencer starts sporting his tuxedo daily because he thinks it's the reason why a woman he met likes him. He is convinced later that she doesn't just like him in his tux because she kisses him (even though the tux is still on, so she might just like him with the tux on).

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly's old friend Missy Robinson returns to Seattle and tries to become Carly's only best friend and replace Sam because she was Carly's best friend first. Sam was given expired chocolate by Missy, and she destroyed Sam's cell phone, and in addition, Missy texted Sam the wrong address to a helicopter base, that she intended to go on with Missy, and Carly. Missy's actions are claimed "accidental", however Sam realizes what Missy is trying to do, but no one believes her as they think Sam is being "her usual paranoid self", because she was being paranoid when she thought Lewbert was an undercover cop, because she thought his giant wart was a spy cam and thought Gibby was a mermaid because he doesn't like wearing shirts. Missy confesses to Sam, but since no one will believe her, she is forced to ask Freddie for help, so when Freddie wins a six month cruise, he gives it to Missy so she will go away. Shortly after Missy is awarded with the cruise, Carly discovers Missy's plans to destroy her and Sam's friendship. Meanwhile, while packing for a camping trip, Spencer is locked in the basement by a psychotic boy, Chuck, seeking revenge from Spencer for telling on him and getting him grounded in the episode "iHurt Lewbert". Chuck is eventually caught at the end of the episode and is grounded by his father.

programme.title: Henry Danger

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

Can the Penguins stop her before she destroys the city? Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. programme.title: Female Gaze
programme.desc: Today, we meet Claire Picheyre, a 32-year-old self-taught photographer living in the Ariège region of southern France. Introduced to photography by her father at an early age, Claire first turned to the medium as a way of preserving memories and resisting oblivion. Over time, she developed a unique form of visual diary, using photography to capture the fleeting moments that shape a life. Her work gradually evolved into a deeply personal exploration through self-portraiture. By placing herself in front of the camera, Claire examines her body, its transformations, its vulnerabilities, and its strength. She photographs herself throughout every stage of her life, during moments of joy as well as periods of hardship. Each image becomes an intimate dialogue between photographer and subject—a confrontation that ultimately leads to self-acceptance. Through this body of work, Claire seeks to encourage women to reconnect with their bodies and reclaim them from objectification, while preserving a subtle sense of sensuality and erotic ambiguity. Photographers are rarely seen in front of the lens. For Claire, self-portraiture is a way to reclaim her own image, bear witness to the passing of time, and leave behind a visual trace of her existence.

programme.title: Tiksimies stacijā!
programme.desc: 19. gadsimta 80. gados, kad Rīgas un Liepājas ostas Krievijas impērijā vairs nevarēja nodrošināt visu preču eksportu, radās iecere izmantot neaizsalstošo Ventspils ostu. Līniju Ventspils-Maskava gan atklāja vien 1901. gadā. Tas bija privāts dzelzceļš, bet Padomju Krievija 1918. gadā privāto sabiedrību nacionalizēja, un tas pārgāja valsts īpašumā. Pirmās kravas bija graudi, uz Eiropu caur Ventspili nokļuva arī sviests no Sibīrijas. Tagadējā Latvijas teritorijā šis ir garākais dzelzceļš posmā no Zilupes līdz Ventspilij. 2001. gadā pasažieru satiksme iecirknī Ventspils-Tukums II tika pārtraukta, pēc septiņiem gadiem atjaunota, bet 2010. gadā slēgta pavisam. Iedzīvotāji joprojām cer uz pasažieru pārvadājumu atjaunošanu. Kas šobrīd notiek greznajā Ventspils stacijā, kāpēc Elkšķenē ir divas stacijas un kādus stāstus glabā Ugāle, brauksim ciemos un uzzināsim.

programme.title: Māksla LV
programme.desc: Šis būs vislietišķākais no visiem raidījumiem par mākslu, jo apskatīs lietišķo mākslu. Mikus apskatīs Aleksandras Beļcovas un Romana Sutas ieguldījumu lietišķajā mākslā. Viņš arī mēģinās atkārtot Aleksandras Beļcovas veikumu. Kā viņam tas izdosies? Drošības pēc Mikus arī lūgs speciālistu palīdzībā Beļcovas šķīvja kopijas izveidei. Viņa mākonītis, pareizāk, šķīvis sanāks - ar zelta maliņu. Bet tikmēr pie Podnieku skolas dalībnieka Ilmāra Veceļa skaidrosim, kas ir svēpēšana, bet kas - redukcija, ar ko tās atšķiras, ja atšķiras. Mikus arī skaidros, kas ir porcelāns, kā to veido un kā to var mīkstu padarīt.

programme.title: Ziņkārīgais Čiekurs ciemos pie Sofi
programme.desc: Ar ko atšķiras kill un no-kill dzīvnieku patversmes, kā tiek finansēta patversmju darbība un kas notiek 15. dienā, kad suns vai kaķis ir nonācis pie glābējiem, to skaidrosim jaunākajā "Ziņkārīgais Čiekurs ciemos pie Sofi" epizodē. Tāpat kopā ar nozares ekspertiem un dzīvnieku mīļotājiem spēlēsim gan Par/Pret spēli, gan viņiem būs iespēja krāt naudu savam labdarības projektam, cenšoties pareizi atbildēt uz jautājumiem Sofi labdarības spēlē.

programme.title: Dzīvot un sadzīvot
programme.desc: Jauns, nebijis TV raidījums "Dzīvot un sadzīvot", kas cilvēkiem ļaus pieņemt un izprast savu slimību, iemācīties ar to sadzīvot, mazinot tās negatīvās izpausmes, lai spētu dzīvot kvalitatīvi, nekļūstot par slimības upuri un nastu tuviniekiem. Tas ir iespējams, uzturot regulāru kontaktu ar ārstu. Izmantojot jaunākās medicīnas inovācijas un pieeju, pacienti veiksmīgi var sadzīvot ar diagnozi, kaut sākotnēji šķiet - nākotne vairs nav iespējama! Sniegsim arī atbalsta plecu pacientu tuviniekiem, kas nereti sajūtas ķīlnieka lomā. Šis ir projekts par partnerību pacientam, viņa tuviniekiem un ārstam. Mūsdienās ārsts nav tikai speciālists, kas atklāj slimības un ārstē tās. Ārsts ir uzticams partneris ilgam un, galvenais, kvalitatīvam mūžam, jo pieaugot cilvēku dzīves ilgumam, tikai loģiski pieaug arī hronisko slimību apjoms, kuras mūsdienās ir iespējams lieliski pārvaldīt. Kā? To visu uzzināsiet 12 raidījumu ciklā ""Dzīvot un sadzīvot"", kas pie skatītājiem nonāks jau 6.oktobrī 22.00 kanālā ReTV. Raidījuma vadītaja, koučs Iveta Komisāre-Gorodņičija, kas sadarbībā ar Veselības centru apvienības vadošajiem ekspertiem ļaus skatītājiem būt līdzestīgiem diskusijai raidījumā "Dzīvot un sadzīvot".
